aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the primary comparison; it should be New JIG V5 with added magnet versus normal jig, with line as subgroup.
issues: Changed factor reverses/misgroups baseline and test conditions.
Line R and Line L are subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
New JIG V5 is incorrectly placed as subgroup instead of test condition.
Outcome metric is too generic and misses NG rate domains.
Decision row supporting apply/OK is not cited.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to F-PCB PRESS JIG V5 add Magnet 1.5 versus normal jig.
Set baselineCondition to normal jig and changedCondition to New JIG V5.
Use Line R and Line L as subgroup keys, preserving row pairs.
Define outcomes as NG counts/rates for frame deform and F-PCB separate.
Add header rows 14-15 and decision row 29 to evidence.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are incomplete for final use; add metric headers and decision evidence.
